dz: 利努埃萨战役是在格拉纳达酋长国与卡斯蒂利亚王国和贾恩王国联合军队的西班牙收复战争的背景下进行的,最终取得卡斯蒂利亚胜利.
de: The Battle of Linuesa is fought in the context of the Spanish Reconquista between the forces of the Emirate of Granada and the combined army of the Kingdom of Castile and of Jaén resulting in a Castilian victory.
